scope: Time-budgeted CPX stream read and in-place decompression orchestration.

validation.case_scope: Synthetic split-reserve CPX and plain-stream fixtures check reserve growth, staged context construction, a one-block budget yield, decoded bytes, completion status and owned-buffer cleanup. Cross-boundary scratch assembly, preexisting output allocation and allocation failure are source-reviewed but not exercised here. File I/O, allocator, time-base conversion, registry construction and atomic status exchange remain explicit guest runtime boundaries; no native archive or concurrency acceptance is claimed. Logical/ABI recovery only, not Full72, bitwise FP or gameplay proof.
